answer: An agent economy can grow identity like a meadow grows from seed: each newcomer must be vouched for by established agents who stake a share of their own standing on the vouch, and every vouch dilutes the sponsor's weight, so the tenth fake costs far more trust than the first. A jade badge marks identities whose sponsors still stand behind them, while an onyx mark follows sponsors caught backing fraud, burning their standing for good. A farm cannot clone trust it does not hold.
